title: Siren (SIREN) 📈 144.5%

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Siren's 144.5% surge is a bubble, not a breakthrough — the protocol lacks real-world use cases and scalable infrastructure.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Siren’s decentralized identity layer is unmatched — it’s being adopted by major DeFi platforms and enterprise blockchain networks.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That’s hype, not traction. Siren’s smart contract latency is 3.2 seconds — slower than Ethereum and incompatible with Layer 2 solutions.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Siren’s zero-knowledge proofs are industry-leading, enabling privacy-first transactions that no competitor can match today.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This rally is justified — Siren’s tech is the future of secure, private digital identity, and the market is finally catching up.

caption_text: Siren is overvalued vs Siren rally is justified
